archetype: Accessible Utility / Indian Retail (High Contrast, Earthy Tones)

headings.instruction: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit for English contexts to give a sturdy, modern feel. Ensure bilingual (Hindi) text defaults to a highly readable fallback like 'Hind' or system sans-serif.

body.instruction: Manrope is mandatory for body and tables. It has excellent numerical legibility which is critical for billing, GST calculations, and stock counts.

primary.usage: Top navigation bars, main action buttons (except voice), and active states.

accent_voice.usage: RESERVED strictly for the Push-to-Talk microphone button and voice-activated highlights. Represents energy and attention.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind colors matching these hex codes (indigo-900 for primary, orange-600 for accent, stone-100 for background). Do NOT use generic gradients. Keep colors flat and high-contrast.

mobile_first_pos.structure: Fixed Top Header (Status/Shop Name) + Scrollable Main Content + Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar/Actions.
mobile_first_pos.voice_fab: A massive, prominent, absolute-positioned Push-to-Talk button anchored slightly above the bottom navigation. It must be accessible via thumb at all times.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4. Prioritize density.
grids.inventory_table: Full-width table, cardless container, striped rows (bg-slate-50 for even rows). Minimize cell padding (p-2) to maximize data density.
grids.split_payment: Bento-style 2-column grid for Cash vs. Online vs. Udhari input fields.

layouts.spacing: Dense on tables and lists, generous (p-4 or p-6) on Voice Draft cards to isolate focus.

voice_fab.style: h-16 w-16 rounded-full bg-orange-600 shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white ring-4 ring-orange-600/30

draft_confirmation_card.style: border-2 border-amber-500 bg-amber-50 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-md
draft_confirmation_card.content: Must clearly show 'Old Value' with strikethrough -> 'New Value' in bold green. Two distinct CTA buttons: 'Confirm (Tick)' and 'Cancel (Cross)'.

pdf_preview_modal.style: max-w-3xl mx-auto bg-stone-200 p-2 md:p-4 rounded-xl
pdf_preview_modal.content: The actual A4 aspect ratio preview of the jsPDF output centered like a physical piece of paper. Add a shadow-xl to the paper.

badges.low_stock: bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold border border-rose-200
badges.godown: bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold
badges.showroom: bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold

components.instructions: Use Shadcn components heavily customized for density. Override Shadcn Card padding from p-6 to p-3/p-4 for mobile.

motion.interactions: All buttons must have active:scale-95 and transition-transform. Do NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.voice_active: Implement a CSS radar pulse keyframe animation or framer-motion ripple effect originating from the Mic button when the user is speaking.
motion.draft_appearance: Draft cards must slide up from the bottom (translate-y-10 to translate-y-0 with opacity) to demand immediate attention.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use hard 1px borders (border-slate-200) instead of soft shadows for data lists. This creates a functional, 'Tally-like' reliable aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for the live transcript floating bar (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80 text-white) to ensure it's readable over any background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Orange accent MUST have white text.
accessibility.bilingual: Keep UI text concise to accommodate both Hindi and English character widths. Devanagari script is taller; ensure line-heights are 'leading-relaxed' in lists.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, forms, and draft cards. e.g. data-testid='voice-mic-button', data-testid='draft-confirm-btn'.

images.description: Indian shopkeeper in a retail environment. Use with a heavy gradient overlay (bg-indigo-950/80) for the login or landing screen.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize on solid/bold variants for primary actions, thin variants for secondary data.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts for data apps. Left-align text, right-align currency/numbers.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays, modals, or bottom nav bars. Always use solid or heavily blurred glass.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
The 'Push-to-Talk' workflow is the soul of this app. The Mic button must be visually dominant on the screen.
Every draft (stock update, billing, udhari payment) MUST pause the app flow and require a manual click to confirm. This is the 'confirm-before-commit' rule.
